User is planning a November trip to the Japanese Alps in Nagano Prefecture with friends from Tokyo, staying in/near Matsumoto. They want to visit the Japanese Alps Visitor Center and explore regional history/culture, traditional architecture, temples, shrines, castles, and onsen. Tentative itinerary: Japanese Alps Visitor Center, Matsumoto Castle, Nawate Street, Matsumoto Folkcraft Museum, and Zenko-ji Temple if time permits. They especially enjoy traditional Japanese culture/history and chose Matsumoto over Hakuba for its cultural focus and proximity to the Visitor Center. They previously asked about Tokyo–Nagano transportation by Shinkansen/bus (S1.U1–U6).

User is planning a Yokohama day trip and is drawn to Minato Mirai 21, Red Brick Warehouse, harbor views, and autumn events/illuminations. They specifically want to try kanimeshi, namashirasu, and grilled squid, and may visit Kanemasa, Tsukiji Itadori Uogashi Nihon-Ichi, and Yokohama Central Market. They are interested in checking Yokohama Oktoberfest, the Autumn Leaves Festival, and Minato Mirai illuminations; themes and dates require current verification. They also plan to visit Kawai Shrine and Meiji Shrine to explore Haraju
